# AVR Developers

> AVR Developers crafts future-ready homes in Hyderabad. The company builds luxury residential projects in the Kokapet growth corridor, with a focus on thoughtful design, lasting value, and modern lifestyles. Tagline: "The Address for the Young Spirited."

AVR Developers is a real estate developer based in Kokapet, Hyderabad, India. Registered office: Evania by AVR, SY NO 3, Pipe Line Road, Kokapet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500075. Contact: info@avrdevelopers.com, +91 8889 666678, +91 80000 82399.

## Projects

- [Evania](https://avrdevelopers.com/evania): Ongoing project offering 3.5 & 4 BHK residences in Kokapet, Hyderabad (RERA TG RERA P02400009394). AVR Evania brings premium apartments designed around mindful living, with intelligent architecture, open spaces, and effortless comfort, for modern lifestyles that value flexibility, wellness, and meaningful experiences. Set within a thoughtfully planned gated community with a 2-level clubhouse.
- [Avira](https://avrdevelopers.com/avira): Ongoing project offering ultra-luxury 3 & 3.5 BHK residences in Kokapet, Hyderabad (RERA TG RERA P02400011038), 172 units across 2 towers, 11 floors. Situated in one of the city's emerging growth corridors, placing residents at the intersection of convenience, connectivity, and future potential.
